Writing Exercises
questions.text: Explain what it mean to factor a polynomial completely.

context: Writing Exercises
questions.text: The difference of squares \({y}^{4}-625\) can be factored as \(({y}^{2}-25)({y}^{2}+25).\) But it is not completely factored. What more must be done to completely factor.

context: Writing Exercises
questions.text: Of all the factoring methods covered in this chapter (GCF, grouping, undo FOIL, ‘ac’ method, special products) which is the easiest for you? Which is the hardest? Explain your answers.

context: Writing Exercises
questions.text: Create three factoring problems that would be good test questions to measure your knowledge of factoring. Show the solutions.
